title: Wet ink
description: A booking form’s signature field on real paper — the pen signs itself, rests, and a glossy bead of ink swells, wicks out along the fibres and dries into a dark coffee ring. Sign it yourself and every stroke stays wet and shiny for a couple of seconds, so you can smear it, pool it, or blot it with Sign and book.
intent: One mechanic finished to the edge: a GPU paper-and-ink simulation inside an ordinary signature field, where pooling, feathering, coffee-ring drying and a blotter offprint all come from the same water and pigment.
